idea-plugin.name: C/C++ Colored Brackets
idea-plugin.description:
Colors matching bracket pairs in C/C++ files by nesting level, like VS Code's bracket pair colorization.
  • 4 levels by default. Add more colors to color deeper levels, or turn on repeating colors.
  • Change the color order, and choose which bracket types to color: ( ), [ ], { } and template < >.
  • Optional indent coloring (off by default), using the bracket colors or a color list of its own.
  • Quick toggles and customization from the status bar icon at the bottom of the window.
Full settings are under Settings | Editor | C/C++ Colored Brackets.
